glm-5.3.name: GLM-5.3
steps: Watch the process memory curve in the terminal
Take heap snapshots and diff object growth between two of them
Trace the growth to event listeners that are never removed
Apply the fix and write a regression test
answer: Found and fixed (sample output): each request registers a listener that is never removed when the connection closes, so objects grow linearly with the request count.
- Patch: call removeListener in the close handler, one file and four lines
- Regression test: simulate 10,000 connections and assert that heap growth stays under 5%
- After the fix, a 30-minute load test keeps memory flat
